title: A.2478 — Establishes Artificial Intelligence Ethics Board in DOLWD.
mechanism: A person or entity selling or offering for sale an AI technology in New Jersey shall conduct an artificial intelligence impact assessment before the sale or offer for sale, within the immediately preceding year. Each assessment is conducted by an independent auditor. The Artificial Intelligence Ethics Board shall establish minimum requirements for these assessments and shall recommend worker displacement protections to the commissioner.
thresholds: Any person or entity selling or offering for sale an artificial intelligence technology in New Jersey. Such a technology is a product or service that primarily uses artificial intelligence to perform its intended function.
